note: Hand-curated: AMR minister title, and the dates (inclusive, ISO) it holds for, to a PofBC ministry episode id (src/government/episodes.js MINISTRY_EPISODES). Dates are cabinet changes as the AMR listings show them (base OICs 213/2017 from 2017-07-18, 602/2020 from 2020-11-26, 658/2022 from 2022-12-07, 596/2024 from 2024-11-18) and, inside a cabinet, the listings a title first or last appears in. episodeId null means deliberately unmapped (see reason); a title missing here, or matched by two entries, goes to research/audit/amr-review.json. Read by scripts/build-government-amr.mjs, which fails on an unknown episode id.
